storage.definition: immutable revision distinct from CAS cursor and due ledger
storage.due_identity: unique across all revisions on (schedule_id, scheduled_at); monotone sequence and high water
storage.work: transactional instance queue sequence, atomic pending to claimed, explicit start, session FIFO and fenced lease
storage.v2_placeholder_upgrade: disabled, unverified metadata preserved; existing pending work order preserved and started work not replayed

scheduling.disable_archive: cancel not-yet-enqueued intents; already admitted runs require explicit cancellation
scheduling.unknown_review: per occurrence, typed intent identity, state, fingerprint and restore generation; preserves unknown states and held costs

recovery.expired_lease: fences late success; no takeover while previous run is nonterminal
recovery.restore: quarantine old queued/live work; pending/sending deliveries become unknown; pause all schedules; invalidate old review generation
recovery.fees: unknown reservations remain held; snapshot cannot reconstruct usage after capture
recovery.incomplete_restore: startup and diagnostic blocker until completion marker validated and cleared

operations: include archived definitions as read-only history with cancellation access
